skill.displayName: Football Player DNA — AI Similarity Search
skill.summary: Football player DNA similarity search — find style-matched alternatives at lower market values using AI vector search across 56,000+ players

latestVersion.changelog:
football-player-dna 1.0.0

- Initial release of "football-player-dna": AI-powered DNA similarity search for footballers using the Rising Transfers Intelligence API.
- Enables style-matched player alternatives and cheaper statistical "twins" across 56,000+ profiles.
- Supports searches by player name (with optional team) and returns detailed similarity matches, value, and playing style data.
- Requires RT_API_KEY for API access; error handling and privacy information included.
- Clear instructions and user prompts for finding, comparing, or scouting similar football players.
